## Entry summary

What shipped, in one sentence:

## Checklist

- [ ] Filename matches `YYYY-MM-DD-kebab-slug.md`
- [ ] Frontmatter date matches the filename date
- [ ] `products` list uses slugs from `products.yml`
- [ ] Lead with the user benefit, not the implementation
- [ ] No internal jargon, Jira IDs, or project codenames
- [ ] Body is ≤ 400 words

CI will catch most of this, but reviewers shouldn't have to.
